name: l0_eflags_word
about: CBaseEntity::GetEFlags 0x100b4ef0 (slot 83: `MOV EAX,[ECX+0x268]; RET`) and CBaseEntity::SetEFlags 0x100b4f10 (slot 84: `MOV EAX,[ESP+4]; MOV [ECX+0x268],EAX; RET 4`) share one complete-word contract over m_iEFlags (+0x268) (`walks/L0-r015.md`). Fresh entity: the base constructor 0x1009d980 leaves 0x54000 in the word -- its SetCollisionBounds(zero, zero) (0x1009dca4 -> 0x1009edc0 -> 0x100dc770) ends in FUN_100dda20's `|= 0x14000` (0x100dda23; the edict is still NULL, so FUN_100ddd20 adds no 0x8000), then 0x1009dcdc ORs 0x50000 -- so a logic_relay that nothing has parented or moved reads 0x54000 (bits 14, 16, 18 set; 0x800, 0x8000 and 0x1000000 clear). SetEFlags(0x01014000) is a whole-dword replace, no mask and no OR: GetEFlags then returns exactly 0x01014000 -- the constructor's 0x40000 is gone, and bit 24 in the argument runs no untouch enqueue (SetEFlags is not SetCheckUntouch). SetEFlags(0x2) (EFL_DORMANT) leaves exactly 0x2: bits 14, 16 and 24 gone. The two are reached as the engine reaches them, through CServerNetworkProperty::vfunc2 / vfunc3 (0x101ab690 / 0x101ab6b0), which forward to the owner's slots 83 / 84; the 124 `*DAT_1070b22c` slot 83/84 sites in the corpus are VEngineServer014's, not these. Reported as `fail`, a read word or a site payload differs from retail's.
notes: 16859136 = 0x01014000 (bits 14, 16, 24; no bit 0, so slot 116 IsMarkedForDeletion stays out of the record) and 344064 = 0x54000. The entity is a map row (its constructor ran at Load), so the fresh-word probe reads what construction and the spawn pass left: a logic_relay has no move parent and nothing moves it, so no 0x800 lands and the word is the constructor's. The `never` on 0x1054000 pins the replace: a setter that ORed instead of storing would keep the constructor's 0x40000. EFL_DORMANT (0x2) on a live logic_relay only skips a later ServerActivate pass (0x100a8220), which the record does not run.
